prompt: An aquarium tunnel with sharks and rays overhead

intent.setting: An illuminated underwater aquarium tunnel; water is visible in a curving glass ceiling overhead with stylized sharks, manta rays and jellyfish drifting past.
intent.goal: Stroll slowly through the tunnel, pausing at the wide observation bay and the tide-pool alcove on the right to watch the water show.
intent.fail: Falling into or touching the water in the glass ceiling
intent.headline: Tunnel must include sharks and rays overhead
